name: Hangzhou Greatstar Industrial Co., Ltd
summary: Hangzhou Greatstar Industrial Co., Ltd engages in research and development, production, and sales of hand, power, and industrial tools in China and internationally. The company offers mechanic tools, pneumatic tools, laser tools/LIDAR, tool storage, vacuum cleaners, and labor protection products under the ARROW, SK, shop.vac, BeA, LISTA, DuraTech, Goldblatt, WORKPRO, PONY JORGENSEN, EverBrite, PREXIS0, OLEI, SWEISS+TECH, PRIME-LINE, scruis, SHEFFIELD, and TESA TECHNOLOGY brand names. It sells its products through department stores, auto parts and other chain supermarkets, and various industrial users, as well as through domestic and foreign e-commerce platforms.
